fresher.question: Tell me about a time you had to learn something new quickly to deliver a project on deadline.
Given an array of integers and a target sum, how would you find whether two numbers add up to the target? Walk through your approach and complexity.
Explain how you would design a URL shortener. What components would you need and what trade-offs would you consider?
Describe a situation where you disagreed with a teammate on a technical approach. How did you handle it?
How would you debug a service that suddenly started returning 500 errors after a deployment?
Implement a function to check if a string has balanced parentheses. Explain edge cases and time complexity.

experienced.question: Design a notification system that can send millions of emails and push notifications reliably.
Tell me about the most complex production incident you resolved. What was your role and what changed afterward?
How would you implement an LRU cache? Discuss data structures, concurrency, and eviction policy.
Walk me through a system you designed where you had to optimize for both latency and cost.
